tickets.completionSummary:
1) What was done
DATA07-R completed on Powerglide in an isolated worktree: four exact LOAD04 training-family loading trials (0001/0002/0003/0005), then the only qualifying native failure received one same-state C pose chunk with B gripper followed by B through the full task. Native strict loading 3/4; repaired conversion 0/1. Family0001 still tipped at tick478 and ended holding the brick near its source: native427.73mm/55.65deg, repaired428.09mm/55.63deg. Boundary physics/controller/history/RNG, RGB/prepared inputs and captured noise qualified; regenerated B branch chunk exact. Videos, contact sheet, complete telemetry and frozen protocol saved. 809 raw files/347341705 bytes independently SHA256-verified on Mint. No training or holdout use. Zero positive repaired examples qualified.

2) Future improvements
The earlier dev0012 acquisition rescue is not a general correction teacher. Keep this failed repair out of positive supervision. Ask planner to select a bounded teacher/earlier-or-longer approach diagnostic before any fitting. Four training families and one repair at one seed do not estimate generalisation. A float64-versus-float32 preflight check was corrected before any prediction/action; preserved and disclosed, with unchanged cases/noise/deadline.

3) Separated work
ALPHA03 #11051 remains Parked by user request. OPS07 #11049 handles the restored Mint mirror and live OST recovery. Any subsequent repair protocol and training require separate tickets. Previous frozen experiment artifacts unchanged.

tickets.title: DATA07-GE — Qualify one geometric-expert continuation from B's failed approach state
tickets.completionSummary:
1) What was done
Executed one unchanged geometric loading expert from DATA07-R B's exact tick460 precontact state on training family0001. State, controller, RNG, RGB and history qualified with the unchanged zero-tolerance comparator. No new VLA inference or training. Expert tipped the brick at530 while gripper still commanded open; first close550, supported lift569 at91.43deg tilt. It transported and released inside the fixture:1.22mm position error and0.016deg yaw, but final tilt90deg. Upright face, placement height and seating failed, so strict0/1 and no correction candidate. Expert internal height-only lift flag was true despite sideways grasp. Saved phase diagnostics and requested/applied commands; B/C archived effective finger motions differed by up to4.90mm before contact, with no workspace clipping in that window. One launch preflight stopped before any expert command due only to86 virtual-environment asset-path aliases; exact original interpreter path resolved it without comparator/physics changes. Preserved both qualifications. Raw223files/161891895bytes SHA256-verified on Mint, code/results/video pushed privately.

2) Future improvements
Stopped this donor/teacher search after the single attempt, as planner required. Reset-state teacher success does not qualify recovery from learner states. Review open-descent contact geometry, requested-versus-achieved motion and upright acquisition before admitting corrective labels. Joint-limit margin reached-0.0030rad; not established causal. No earlier handoff sweep, alternative grasp or fitting authorized by this completion.

3) Separated work
DATA07-R #11050 holds the four native trials and failed learned-pose patch. OPS07 #11049 holds backup/live OST recovery. AlphaNIST #11051 remains Parked. Any controller redesign or later training requires a separate bounded experiment.
